meta: Ask AI to write Excel or Google Sheets formulas in plain words: no need to memorize SUMIFS or VLOOKUP, just describe what you want to calculate.

muc.title: Excel formulas in plain words
muc.text: You don't need to memorize Excel or Google Sheets formulas. Describe what you want to calculate and AI will write the formula.

muc.title: Name the columns and rows
muc.text: Say which column the data is in, which row it starts on and what result you need, for example total revenue by month.

muc.title: Check on three rows
muc.text: Before using it on the whole sheet, test it on three rows where you already know the answer. Use it only if all three match.

muc.title: Ask AI to explain it
muc.text: Ask AI to explain each part of the formula, so you can fix it yourself next time the sheet changes.

muc.title: A calculation you do by hand
muc.text: Describe a calculation you usually do by hand, then test the formula AI writes on three rows you know.
